content.comment_body: Hello, In [product_name], there are 9 parameter pages that display when using the arrow buttons, starting from the page I created. Is there any way to hide these 9 pages?

The [product_name] software does not offer a feature to hide these pages. You can activate the 9 message texts with parameters, for example, only through an external input such as a key switch. Alternatively, you can enable block protection and assign a password, or create another message text with a password prompt—if the correct password is entered, you can then activate your 9 message texts.
Thanks for the response. Which function block would allow me to disable access to the 9 pages?
Thank you for the information. I've been trying to solve this issue with my [product_name] for a while.
@[user_name], I provided a few different approaches. Which method are you trying?
@[user_name], I am attempting to use the first option.
Hello @[user_name], For the first option you only need a digital input for the key switch.

Are you referring to these pages? [IMAGE] Those particular pages cannot be locked or removed. You would need to request a design change for future models, or use a [product_name] version without an integrated screen.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are disappointed that the default 9 parameter pages on the [product_name] display cannot be hidden or disabled due to limitations in the software and hardware. While different workarounds are discussed, none fully address the desire for a simpler, more customizable HMI experience, and the restriction appears to be a core design feature.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to hide or restrict access to the standard 9 parameter pages to create a more customized and secure HMI interface.
